description: Conformance monitoring (2021/664 Art. 13(1); brief WP-10). judge cases: one sample against an intent_active value (intent/state/v1, the fixtures' authorisations, with optional thresholds and policy overrides), read through internal/conformance.AuthorisationOf and judged by conformance.Judge; expected is the verdict, or error naming the refused field. sequence cases: one fresh conformance.Tracker per case on the fixtures' sequence_config, flight and authorisation; each step is observe (a track sample at wall time t_s, read through conformance.InputOf; sample fields default to sample_defaults), tick (no sample) or drop (the flight ended). expected.per_step[i] is the reported state after step i and the alert kinds it raised and cleared (with the clear reason); active_after the alerts active at the end (detail fields listed are compared); counters the counts the case pins. Positions: lat_deg/lon_deg computed with uspace-core geodesy.Destination from the fixtures (the circle's centre, the square's east edge); the expected numbers are by construction, never computed by the judgement (internal/conformance/genvectors).

units.t_s: seconds after fixtures.now, the monitor's wall clock

tolerance.horizontal: 0.01 m plus 1e-4 of the distance (the tangent-plane nearest point of an edge)

hysteresis_rule: nonconforming returns to conforming, and the nonconformance alert clears resolved, when (placement of an inside sample) - (placement of the last outside sample) > clear_after_s; an undetermined sample neither refreshes nor shows inside

cases.name: circle-centre-inside
cases.why: The centre of the circle inside the band and the window is inside.

cases.name: circle-just-inside-the-edge
cases.why: 1 cm inside the radius is inside: the circle is judged by geodesic distance from its centre (Z-11).

cases.name: circle-outside-by-1m
cases.why: 1 m outside the outline is outside, within the 50 m horizontal threshold; the vertical band still holds it (within_band).

cases.name: circle-outside-by-h-minus-1
cases.why: 49 m outside is within h_m 50: the Art. 10(2)(d) tolerance.

cases.name: circle-outside-by-just-under-h
cases.why: 1 cm inside h_m is within the threshold. The closed bound itself is pinned on the vertical (above-upper-by-v), where the numbers are exact; a horizontal distance of exactly h_m is a floating-point coin toss.

cases.name: circle-outside-by-h-plus-1
cases.why: 51 m outside is beyond h_m 50: not within the threshold.

cases.name: at-the-upper-limit-inside
cases.why: The upper limit itself is inside (closed band).

cases.name: at-the-lower-limit-inside
cases.why: The lower limit itself is inside (closed band).

cases.name: above-upper-within-v
cases.why: 10 m above the authorised upper AMSL limit is above_upper, within v_m 15 (height conformance is against the authorised upper, PLAN §1).

cases.name: above-upper-by-v
cases.why: Exactly v_m above is within the threshold.

cases.name: above-upper-beyond-v
cases.why: 20 m above is beyond v_m 15.

cases.name: below-lower-within-v
cases.why: 10 m below the lower limit is below_lower, within v_m.

cases.name: below-lower-beyond-v
cases.why: 20 m below is beyond v_m 15.

cases.name: before-start-within-t
cases.why: 30 s before the window opens is before_start, within t_s 60.

cases.name: before-start-beyond-t
cases.why: 61 s before the window is beyond t_s 60.

cases.name: after-end-within-t
cases.why: 10 s after the window closes is after_end, within t_s.

cases.name: after-end-beyond-t
cases.why: Two minutes after the window is beyond t_s.

cases.name: at-the-window-end-inside
cases.why: The window is closed: its end is inside.

cases.name: after-end-and-outside-reports-the-time
cases.why: Outside the window and the outline: the reason is the time, and the horizontal excess (60 m, beyond h_m) is reported and counted in the threshold.

cases.name: outside-horizontally-and-above
cases.why: Outside both ways: the reason is horizontal, both excesses are reported, and the vertical one (40 m) is beyond v_m.

cases.name: pressure-inside-only-with-the-margin
cases.why: A pressure altitude 100 m above the upper is inside the band widened by 250 m (R-09), so it is inside but within_band is false (04 §3.1).

cases.name: pressure-inside-the-band
cases.why: A pressure altitude inside the band as given is within_band.

cases.name: pressure-beyond-the-margin
cases.why: 870 m pressure is 20 m above the widened upper (850 m): above_upper, measured from the widened band.

cases.name: geodetic-at-the-same-altitude-is-outside
cases.why: The pair of the pressure case: a geodetic 700 m has no margin and is 100 m above the upper.

cases.name: pressure-margin-zero
cases.why: With no pressure margin configured, a pressure altitude is judged against the band as given.

cases.name: network-altitude-inside
cases.why: A network altitude is a vertical position like a geodetic one.

cases.name: unknown-vertical-alt-source-none
cases.why: alt_source none: the vertical judgement is not evaluated and the verdict says so; it is never inside by default (E-15, SC-22).

cases.name: unknown-vertical-value-with-none-source
cases.why: An altitude with source none is not a vertical position: undetermined.

cases.name: unknown-vertical-outside-horizontally
cases.why: Without the vertical, the horizontal judgement still runs: 100 m outside is outside and beyond h_m.

cases.name: square-inside
cases.why: Inside a polygon volume.

cases.name: square-outside-east-by-30m
cases.why: 30 m east of the square's east edge: the distance is to the nearest edge.

cases.name: square-outside-east-by-80m
cases.why: 80 m east of the edge is beyond h_m.

cases.name: square-above
cases.why: The polygon's band is judged like the circle's.

cases.name: corridor-first-volume
cases.why: Two volumes in sequence: at T0 the first is active and holds the aircraft.

cases.name: corridor-second-volume
cases.why: At T0 + 10 min the second volume is active and holds the aircraft.

cases.name: corridor-wrong-volume-for-the-time
cases.why: At T0 the aircraft is where the second volume will be: only the first is active, 2000 - 500 = 1500 m away.

cases.name: corridor-handover-instant
cases.why: At the handover instant both windows are closed sets, so the second volume already holds it.

cases.name: threshold-h-zero-refuses
cases.why: A zero horizontal threshold refuses the judgement; it never disarms it (E-15).

cases.name: threshold-v-negative-refuses
cases.why: A negative vertical threshold refuses the judgement (E-15).

cases.name: threshold-t-zero-refuses
cases.why: A zero time threshold refuses the judgement (E-15).

cases.name: thresholds-missing-refuses
cases.why: An intent without deviation thresholds cannot be judged and is never judged as conforming.

cases.name: pressure-margin-negative-refuses
cases.why: A negative pressure margin refuses the judgement (E-15).

cases.name: invalid-position-refuses
cases.why: A position that is not WGS84 is not judged (C-09).

cases.name: t-persistence-then-raise
cases.why: Outside within the thresholds is tolerated for t_s (60 s); it is nonconforming once it persists beyond t_s, with the verdict's reason.

cases.name: threshold-exceeded-raises-at-once
cases.why: An excess beyond h_m is nonconforming at once (threshold_exceeded), raised by the first sample: the alert latency starts at its captured_at.

cases.name: height-above-upper-beyond-v-raises
cases.why: Height above the authorised upper beyond v_m is a nonconformance (S-M2: including height above the authorised upper).

cases.name: return-within-hysteresis-does-not-clear
cases.why: Shown inside for 3 s since last outside is not more than clear_after_s: the alert holds (C-06).

cases.name: return-beyond-hysteresis-clears-resolved-with-numbers
cases.why: Shown inside for more than 3 s since last outside: cleared resolved, carrying the last numbers that showed it outside and the numbers that cleared it (C-14).

cases.name: refresh-carries-current-numbers
cases.why: Raised once; a later sample refreshes silently with the current numbers (C-06, C-08).

cases.name: contingent-after-60s-without-returning
cases.why: Nonconforming for MaxRecoverableTimeInNonconformingStateSeconds (60 s) without returning goes contingent (F3548, 02 F6); the alert stays active.

cases.name: return-before-60s-is-not-contingent
cases.why: A flight back inside before 60 s returns to conforming and never goes contingent.

cases.name: contingent-stays-after-return
cases.why: Contingent is kept until the flight ends (F3548 has no way back to Activated); the alert itself clears resolved when the aircraft is shown inside.

cases.name: lost-link-raised-and-cleared
cases.why: 15 s without a live sample raises lost_link (02 F5); lost telemetry is non-conformance (telemetry_lost), so the flight is nonconforming until shown inside for the hysteresis after the link is back.

cases.name: lost-link-then-contingent
cases.why: Silence is not evidence of a return: 60 s after the link was lost the flight is contingent, and the lost_link alert carries the current silence (C-08).

cases.name: lost-link-not-for-a-grounded-aircraft
cases.why: An aircraft whose last sample said Ground is not lost when it goes quiet (C-05).

cases.name: lost-link-not-without-an-authorisation
cases.why: A flight never judged against an authorisation has nothing to conform to: unknown, and no lost_link.

cases.name: backlog-samples-ignored
cases.why: History is never alerted (T-04): a backlog sample far outside raises nothing.

cases.name: late-samples-ignored
cases.why: A sample received 11 s before the wall is late beyond live_max_age_s 10 (T-05) and judges nothing.

cases.name: out-of-order-sample-ignored
cases.why: A sample placed before the one held never overwrites it (T-06).

cases.name: placed-ahead-refused
cases.why: A sample placed 2 s ahead of its receipt (tolerance 1 s) is a clock ahead and is refused.

cases.name: disabled-source-clears-source-disabled
cases.why: A switched-off source clears its alerts as source_disabled (B-11), is held unknown without a lost_link, and the next sample from the enabled source raises again.

cases.name: ground-sample-not-judged
cases.why: Alert only on flying aircraft (C-05): Ground is not flying and Undeclared is not known to be.

cases.name: flight-end-clears-flight-ended
cases.why: Ending the flight clears its alerts as flight_ended, never resolved.

cases.name: undetermined-never-clears
cases.why: A sample whose vertical was not evaluated does not show the flight inside: nothing unjudged clears an alert (C-09).

cases.name: undetermined-first-judgement-stays-unknown
cases.why: With no altitude ever the flight was never shown inside its band: unknown (vertical_not_evaluated), never conforming by default (SC-22); the first sample with an altitude judges it.

cases.name: within-threshold-return-before-t-stays-conforming
cases.why: The E-01 twin of t-persistence-then-raise: back inside before t_s, nothing is raised.

cases.name: authorisation-missing-is-unknown
cases.why: No intent_active entry: the flight is unknown, never conforming, and counted (SC-22).

cases.name: invalid-thresholds-judge-nothing
cases.why: An authorisation whose thresholds refuse the judgement leaves the flight unknown: it is never read as conforming (E-15).
